coverage.description: Register a contact that completes the epee circuit while rejecting grounded material.
Apply the selected epee double-hit window and retain an opposing hit at its boundary.
Enforce the epee contact-duration and exceptional-resistance behavior, including the two-millisecond minimum.
Reject epee hits on earthed material while preserving an opposing valid contact.
Verify the loud epee sound signal, its correlation with the visual event, and its reset latch.
Register a foil hit when the circulating circuit breaks and distinguish on-target, off-target, and audio outcomes.
Qualify foil circuit breaks across the 13 to 15 millisecond duration and 0 to 500 ohm resistance boundaries.
Reject foil guard, piste, and non-depressed jacket contacts while preserving valid blade-contact behavior.
Verify anti-blocking foil behavior, valid and non-valid resistance outcomes, and the two yellow insulation diagnostics.
Apply per-side foil inhibit and the 300 millisecond bout lockout after the first signalled hit.
Register sabre contact with the opposing conductive jacket, glove, or mask while rejecting non-conductive surfaces.
Show sabre own-equipment yellow diagnostics and persistent white circuit-fault indications for abnormal B or C changes.
Reject whipping-over contacts, tolerate up to 100 ohms external resistance, and enforce the 0.1 to 1 millisecond contact range.
Preserve exchanged sabre hits during own-equipment leakage and report the faulty-side yellow diagnostic range.
Register an opposing sabre hit only within the selected 170 millisecond lockout window while retaining blade-contact rules.
Apply sabre blade-contact history, interruption limits, whipover recovery, and the 0 to 20 millisecond timing boundaries.
Detect a sabre control-circuit break above 250 ohms for the qualified three-millisecond duration and latch the white lamp.
